:::{#def-sd}
#### Standard deviation

The **standard deviation** of a [random variable](random-variables.qmd#def-random-variable) $X$
is the [square root](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-square-root) of the [variance](#def-variance) of $X$:

$$\SD{X} \eqdef \sqrt{\Var{X}}$$

:::
